lines: d17: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Tom Cui is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d17: 🕯️ Tom Cui is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d17: What Tom kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d17: "Tom's gone." Kayden looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Tom." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d17: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Jesse blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d17: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d17: 📖 LEARNED: Boiling Water (Level 1). Rolling boil for 1 minute kills most pathogens. The simplest safe water.
d17: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d17: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d17: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Tom Cui, 17 days. The mantle passes to Jesse Cortez.
d17: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Jesse Cortez, 40 — a line cook. His hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d17: The village's quarrel was with Tom — and Tom is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d17: The fire knew Jesse — solid ground, earned at this fire.
